text:
BC Place daa 19 June 1983 sɛ wiase mu dome stadium a ɛso paa a wɔde mframa bɔɔ mu, na ne dome a wɔde ntoma bɔɔ mu no yɛɛ Vancouver agyiraeɛ biako. Studio Phillips Barratt na ɛyɛɛ ne ho nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔde CA$126.1 million bɔɔ mu — a ɛyɛ CA$356 million wɔ 2025 sika mu. British Columbia Province na ɛwɔ mu na BC Pavilion Corporation (PavCo) na ɛhwɛ so, na wɔyɛɛ no sɛ ɛbɛyɛ beaeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ kurow no nkitahodie ne agorɔ akɛseɛ nyinaa.

Ɛfiri mfitiaseɛ no ɛyɛɛ BC Lions a wɔwɔ CFL no fie, na wɔn tenancy no afi 1983. Ne din trɛɛ mfeɛ bebree mu: BC Place yɛɛ beaeɛ titiriw ma 2010 Winter Olympic ne Paralympic Games, na ɛhyɛɛ ne nsesaeɛ ne nsesaeɛ, na ɛda so yɛ Canada Sevens rugby ne BC Sports Hall of Fame fie.

Wɔde bɛyɛɛ no foforɔ wɔ bɛyɛ 16 months, bɛyɛ CA$514 million nsesaeɛ a wɔwieeɛ wɔ 2011 mu. Stantec Architecture na ɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no, na adwuma no sesaa dome a wɔde mframa bɔɔ mu no yɛɛ retractable cable-supported roof — a ɛso paa wɔ wiase — na ɛyɛɛ beaeɛ no foforɔ nanso ɛdaa so wɔ kurow no mfinimfini. Saa afe no ara mu, Vancouver Whitecaps FC baa hɔ sɛ tenant, na ɔne MLS bɛhyɛɛ mu wɔ 2011 na ɔyɛɛ BC Place ne fie.

Ne nkitahodie mu, BC Place wɔ scoreboard a ɛso paa a wɔde bɔɔ mu wɔ North America, a ɛka AT&T Stadium nko ara akyi. Ne soccer pitch no yɛ 117 by 75 yards (107 by 69 m), na ɛretwɛn FIFA 2-star certification. Efi inflatable-domed multipurpose arena kɔ retractable-roof landmark wɔ Canada Pacific coast so, BC Place daa so yɛ ne ho foforɔ nanso ɛyɛ ɔman no stadium a ɛwɔ anim paa mu.
